svg.title: BN254 pairing operations, Narsil against MCL and arkworks
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart of 5 operations on AMD EPYC 9654, in microseconds, where a shorter bar is faster. Each group holds Narsil, MCL and arkworks. On one full pairing, Narsil takes 192 microseconds against 428 for MCL and 784 for arkworks, so 2.2 times faster than MCL and 4.1 times faster than arkworks.
